items.description: Find biographical information about candidates, read reporters' coverage of key races, browse campaign finance data and review the accuracy of candidates' statements.
Gives citizens the information and the tools that they need to expose threats to the public interest, and to hold their elected officials more accountable.
The redistricting following the 2010 Census is an opportunity to change how the redistricting process is conducted. With knowledge and the right tools, the public can redraw the map on redistricting.
Lagunagram pulls photos from Instagram and displays posts from in and around downtown Laguna Beach in real-time.
Track your own and your friends travels
Connected to Us creates a communication system using the hardware your team members and customers already own.
Go Crowdless uses Foursquare check-ins to help you understand when 20 of the most popular attractions are least crowded and most crowded.
A rich, interactive map with the current conditions from thousands of locations worldwide.

RallyBound is a social fundraising platform that lets individuals from around the web to create custom campaigns for their causes. Some of the features available on RallyBound include custom campaign designs, direct donation from supporters, multiple campaign management (one site for multiple campaigns), and more.

A PowerPoint mixer to select a PowerPoint presentation on the fly from SlideShare. It uses the SlideShare.net API and pretty effects by script.aculo.us and prototype.js to select a random slideshow for a given tag.
A mashup site where you can leave your digital footprints that are of emotional value to you. You can post photos and videos by form upload, email or MMS.
See the location of elaborate Christmas lights displays. Readers can add comments and vote for favorites.
MyMemory Language Translator is an application that lets users to translate text from one language to another. This application uses the MyMemory API service.

The free Website Traffic Estimator is designed to quickly discover how many people visit a specific website on a monthly basis. In addition this tools shows you how many pages an average user views during a single session and the average bounce rate. Research and compare your competitors to find out how many monthly visitors they attract.
Painless sharing of your Flickr images by tag or set across Facebook & Twitter. Group sharing supported and multiple accounts supported.
Very nice map featuring locations of photos from the book Birds of Central Park.
Valuate the worth of any website in this free tool. Find data about earnings, revenue, visits, pageviews and net worth.
Create your own maps and share with friends.
This is a mashup showing the capitals of the fify states of the United States and the respective state nicknames
This mashup uses Google Maps to display a detailed illustration of the Vinexpo 2013 facilities. This allows visitors to easily find exactly what they are looking for.
Instant camera allows users to quickly take and edit a photo and then share it with friends. This application uses the Aviary API.
Parkr! is an amusement parks and theme parks database that allows users to rate and comment on parks all over the world.
iBlueSky is a mind mapping application for the iPhone, and this mashup allows users to save mind maps from iBlueSky directly to their Box.net accounts.
A Wordpress plugin that pushes updates to Taglets.org when you publish a post.
Provides small businesses an interface to enter polling questions, possible answers and tabulates the responses to provide valuable information to the merchant. Formerly called Voicify.

Rivr is a new social networking utility, using the Twilio and Twilio SMS Api's. Brings freedom and creativity to a social network.

YouTorials is an assemblage of free video tutorials collected from YouTube. Users can search or browse through hundreds of videos from how to solve a Rubik cube to how to break-dance. Uses can submit their own videos and subscribe via RSS.
See when the next streetcars are coming (Toronto) and watch them move on a map in real time. Desktop and mobile friendly.
Mashup of Google Maps, travel products and an XML feed.
This mashup is an example use of the Infoconnect API with a call center type application.
Location guide to football clubs in the top 16 divisions of English Football. Covers the Premier League, Football League & the top twelve divisions in non-league football.
Shark the Market is an investor relations site using Twitter and Facebook.
App that lets you create and share individual world maps, KML-files and Google Mapplets.
Displays all Montreal subway statons and lines. Markers are placed very accurate. Can display lines separately.
Malta hotels with integrated map of YouTube videos.
Social networking travel websites that creates personalized recommendations for each user based on user interests and user ratings. Uses geotagged Flickr photo stream and Google maps.
Most popular trends on Twitter aggregator.
A map mashup showing the latest videos of the BP gulf oil spill. Track and see the news as it develops.
Use pixurl to search your favorite social platforms all from one web page

Instagr.in is a web-based version of Instagram that supplies to users the complete functionality of Instagram, including browsing user feeds, tagging users & locations, liking/unliking, performing a search of Instagram by keyword or username, commenting, as well as downloading and sharing photos. In addition to these normal functions, a unique aspect of Instagr.in is that the blend tab will aggregate occurrences of identical of users, hashtags, and locations into a single feed.
Displays geographic location of a Domain or IP address on Google Maps.
mapits.de is a German real estate search engine based on Google Maps.
Visitors can use the Street View camera to take a holiday picture. Users can take as many pictures as they like and then submit them for a chance to win a holiday in Majorca.

A mashup that imports missed connection data from craigslist and locates them on the google map. The time slider on the top of the map enables users to go back the past 10 days. A submission page with a drawing board is provided so users can submit their missed connection via the website with a drawing.

MagTrack is a mobile app for Magento store owners. Use MagTrack's Android app to track sales data in real time, and receive push notifications about sales activity. The app tracks information like total sales, bestsellers, and order and customer details.
Map of March 2008 protests in Tibet, and ensuing events. With photos, summaries, and links to supporting documentation about the Tibetan Centre for Human Rights and Democracy, TCHRD, website.

LazyLibrary lets you find books on any topic without having to worry about high page counts. If it is over 200 pages, you will not even see it. Read all about anything, in less time, for usually less money.
